title: The Dragon issue-23 opener part two: Random Generation of Creatures from the Lower Planes (census 874)

banner.title: The Dragon issue-23 opener part two - the Lower Planes creature generator
banner.provenance: The part-two round of the issue-23 four-round shape - the single chain of the Sorceror Scroll DMG preview, the table round of the walk: the Random Generation of Creatures from the Lower Planes system, Gary Gygax on the Abyss, Tarterus, Hades, Gehenna and Hell. Pinned from The Dragon Vol. III No. 9 (March 1979) print 15 through 18 at extract/dragon/023, PRINT FOLIO = PDF PAGE this issue, the transcript of the Curtiss-provided scan. The Rihn and Pickens antecedents ride the frame; the EXXEDUUNUSSE sign-off rides the general characteristics; the two inherited watches - the Sullin levels 7-9 and the brawling sequel - print nowhere in issue 23 and ride to TD 24.

audit_label: R951 issue-23 Lower Planes generation audit
audit_anchor: #include "rules/audits/r950_batch.h"  // R950: R950 issue-23 variant triptych audit
audit_comment: THE SORCEROR SCROLL LOWER-PLANES GENERATOR AUDIT - the issue-23 part-two table round, the Random Generation of Creatures from the Lower Planes system headed into the forth coming DUNGEON MASTERS GUIDE. The base stat block, the twenty-three appearance and generation grids, the strength-to-hit-damage bands, the attack forms, the special attacks and defenses and the optional-poison footnote all ride this single chain, print 15 through 18.
